query: WITH changed AS (INSERT INTO endpoint_tools(endpoint_id,source_id,upstream_name) SELECT $1,source_id,name FROM unnest($2::uuid[],$3::text[]) targets(source_id,name) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING source_id,upstream_name) INSERT INTO control_changes(request_id,workspace_id,kind,item,action) SELECT $4,$1,'scope',t.path,'include' FROM changed c JOIN tools t ON t.source_id=c.source_id AND t.upstream_name=c.upstream_name
